001: Haoran, have you moved into your new place?
Yes, I've moved in. It's in a neighborhood right next to the school.
The room isn't big, but the sunlight is really nice.
Sounds great. Is the rent expensive?
It's two thousand yuan a month. I think it's a pretty good deal.
002: Jingyi, is your living room big?
It's pretty big, and it's connected to a small balcony.
So what do you guys usually do in the living room?
In the evening, the family watches TV and chats together.
I'm so jealous. I want to live in a big house too.
Come over and hang out whenever you're free. You're always welcome.
003: Zixuan, what color are the walls in your room?
I painted them light blue. It looks really comfortable.
What about the furniture? Did you buy it all new?
The bed and desk are new, but the wardrobe is old.
An old wardrobe is fine too. As long as it works.
Right, and I used the money I saved to buy a desk lamp.
004: Jiaqi, is your kitchen fully equipped?
Pretty much. We have an oven and a microwave.
So, do you cook for yourself usually?
I cook on weekends. During the week I'm too busy, so I eat at the cafeteria.
Cooking for yourself is definitely healthier.
Yeah, and it's a lot cheaper than eating out.
005: Tianyou, is your room far from the bathroom?
Not far. Just a few steps out the door and you're there.
That's pretty convenient. You don't have to worry at night.
The only thing is the bathroom is a bit small. It's not very comfortable.
Small has its advantages too. It's faster to clean.
That's true. I can wipe it down in ten minutes.
006: Yuxuan, is there a supermarket downstairs from your building?
Yes, it's a two-minute walk. Really close.
So it's super convenient for buying groceries and daily necessities, right?
Yeah, if we run out of something at night, we can just go buy it anytime.
There's nothing near my building. It's a real hassle.
Well, you could always move over to this side.
007: Junjie, does your bedroom have room for a desk?
Yeah, it fits. I pushed the bed against the wall.
That's a pretty good use of the space.
Yeah, and it freed up room for a small sofa.
That's really nice. I want to arrange my room like that too.
One of these days, I'll help you figure out how to set it up.
008: Tingting, does your living room have air conditioning?
Yes, it was newly installed last year. It cools down really fast.
Then it must be really cool at home in the summer.
Right, at night we don't even need to turn on a fan to sleep.
My AC is too old. It makes a lot of noise.
Then you should get a new one soon. They're not expensive now.
009: Haoran, does your balcony get any sun?
Yeah, in the afternoon the sunlight comes right in.
So, have you planted any flowers on the balcony?
I've got a few pots of pothos, and one pot of jasmine.
When the jasmine blooms, it must smell really nice, right?
It's super fragrant. You can smell it throughout the whole living room.
010: Jingyi, what's your ideal home like?
It doesn't need to be big, but it has to be clean and bright.
Ideally, there'd be a big bookshelf filled with all my favorite books.
That does sound really cozy, like a little study.
Right, and if I could get a cat too, it would be perfect.
